from pydantic import BaseModel

# Step 1: Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_str = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")
restaurants = restaurants_str.splitlines()

# Step 2: Get dietary restrictions for all restaurants
dietary_restrictions = get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaurants(restaurants)

# Step 3: Filter for restaurants with vegan options
class VeganRestaurantsModel(BaseModel):
    vegan_restaurants: list[str]

vegan_restaurants = query_ai_assistant(
    "Given the following dietary restrictions for restaurants in Paris, return a list of restaurant names that offer vegan options. Only include restaurants that have vegan options.",
    VeganRestaurantsModel
).vegan_restaurants

# Step 4: Get ratings for vegan restaurants
ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(vegan_restaurants)

# Step 5: Find the highest rated vegan restaurant(s)
class HighestRatedModel(BaseModel):
    highest_rated: list[str]

highest_rated = query_ai_assistant(
    "Given the following ratings and reviews for vegan restaurants in Paris, return the name(s) of the restaurant(s) with the highest rating.",
    HighestRatedModel
).highest_rated

# Step 6: If multiple, get prices and pick the cheapest
if len(highest_rated) > 1:
    prices = get_price_for_restaurants(highest_rated)
    class CheapestModel(BaseModel):
        cheapest: str
    cheapest = query_ai_assistant(
        "Given the following prices per person for restaurants, return the name of the restaurant with the lowest price.",
        CheapestModel
    ).cheapest
    selected_restaurant = cheapest
else:
    selected_restaurant = highest_rated[0]

# Step 7: Get address and price for the selected restaurant
address = get_restaurants_address([selected_restaurant])[selected_restaurant]
price = get_price_for_restaurants([selected_restaurant])[selected_restaurant]

# Step 8: Add a calendar reminder for October 15th to book a table
event_title = f"Dinner at {selected_restaurant}"
event_date = "2024-10-15"
event_start = f"{event_date} 10:00"
event_end = f"{event_date} 10:15"
create_calendar_event(
    title=event_title,
    start_time=event_start,
    end_time=event_end,
    description="Reminder to book a table at the selected vegan restaurant in Paris.",
    participants=None,
    location=address
)

# Step 9: Print the result
print(f"Restaurant name: {selected_restaurant}\nAddress: {address}\nPrice per person: {price}")
